US Adds 3 Groups to Online Visa Background Vetting

The United States will add three new groups of visa applicants to its online background vetting process starting October 1. This change affects individuals applying for visas and involves enhanced scrutiny through social media checks. The new rule is being implemented to review visa applications more thoroughly.
